summary: Frontend-only validation of the 3-relances no-driver flow on RideTrackingPage. Created a pending SB taxi ride via API, opened /ride/{id}, exercised manual 'Relancer la recherche' button 3 times, validated relance-count text ('Relance 1/3…', '2/3…'), modal appearance, all 3 action buttons (propose/schedule/continue), continue-search reset, schedule-trip → ScheduleCalendarModal → confirm → PUT /reschedule 200 → navigation to /scheduled-rides, and propose-fare → POST /convert-to-bidding 200 → navigation to /taxi-bidding?resume=<id> with the resumed ride visible. ALL 6 acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: RideTrackingPage.js is 791 lines — consider splitting (pool logic, relance logic, status handlers) into focused hooks/modules per file-size guideline (<700 lines).

The auto-relance setInterval effect re-creates the timer whenever `doRebroadcast` identity changes; current useCallback deps are stable, but adding `relanceCount` indirectly via the ref is implicit. Acceptable but worth a comment.
Minor: WebSocket to wss://.../api/ws/... fails to connect (preview ingress likely strips WS upgrade); the 5s polling fallback masks it correctly, but consider logging to a less noisy level.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 pending SB taxi rides via POST /api/rides during the test (ride_dfdfdf87fc9f used for schedule flow, ride_3cd863d06567 used for propose-fare flow). One ended scheduled, the other converted to bidding mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow is mobile-only (430px). Use page.request to login + POST /api/rides then navigate to /ride/{id}; cookies are httpOnly session cookies and are shared with the page context. Manual 'relancer-recherche-btn' increments the same counter as the 20s auto-relance, so 3 manual clicks trigger no-driver-modal instantly. relance-count element is hidden when relanceCount===0 or relanceCount>=MAX_RELANCES (only visible 1/3 and 2/3). After continue-search-btn the counter resets to 0 (relance-count hidden) — verified. Schedule confirm requires picking a future date and time ≥ minimum delay.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Feature implementation matches the spec end-to-end.
